segments.text: Settle into your bed, and let yourself be still. This is your time to let go completely.
Take one slow breath in. And sigh it out. Let the day leave your body with it.
We'll slowly soften the body, from the top of your head all the way down.
Let the muscles of your face relax. Your forehead smooth. Your eyes heavy.
Soften your neck and your shoulders. Let them melt down into the bed.
Feel your chest rise and fall, slow and easy. Your heartbeat, calm.
Let your arms grow heavy. Your hands open and still.
Let the warmth spread through your belly, your hips, softening everything it touches.
Your legs are heavy now. Sinking down. Nothing to hold up anymore.
All the way to your feet. Every part of you, resting.
If a thought arises, let it float past. You don't need to follow it tonight.
Just your breath, slow and gentle. Carrying you deeper with every wave.
You are safe. You are warm. You are allowed to rest.
Let go now. Drift. I'll watch over the quiet. Sleep well.
